name: The Atlantic Hotel
accommodation: A range of sea and harbour-view rooms, balcony suites, the Cliffside Apartment and The Lookout self-catering apartment (sleeps 8)
beachAccess: In the heart of Newquay overlooking the harbour and beaches
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, cocktail bar, spa with indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room
overview: A hotel in the heart of Newquay looking over the harbour and the town beaches, Towan among them. Rooms range from classic doubles to balcony suites, and there is a self-catering apartment that sleeps eight. Spa access is included, with an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna and steam room.
surfTripFit: It is close to Towan and the town beaches, and the spa is a good place to recover after a surf.
